prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: source sheet for a small transparent animated icon on a fashion workflow website
Primary request: Create a square image with EXACTLY four equal square panels arranged in a precise 2x2 layout. Each panel repeats the SAME premium miniature white-clay fashion materials icon in four successive motion phases: a horizontal bolt of rolled fabric with its loose end unwinding into a soft flowing flap, accompanied by one small round button and a short thread spool. Phase 1: fabric neatly rolled, button beside it. Phase 2: fabric begins unrolling and button rolls a little. Phase 3: cloth flap extends furthest, button has moved along it. Phase 4: cloth and button return toward the resting pose. Clearly communicate material selection and textile inventory.
Scene/backdrop: transparent, no environment.
Subject: one compact fabric roll, fabric edge, one button and one tiny thread spool; same objects repeated in all four tiles.
Style/medium: charming premium softly rounded white-clay/paper 3D miniature icon, tactile matte white surfaces with pale neutral-grey dimensional shading, refined fashion illustration, sophisticated friendly craft, not vector.
Composition/framing: fixed camera and identical centered object position, silhouette scale and studio lighting in every tile; ample transparent margin in each tile; exact 2x2 panel placement; keep every object wholly within its tile.
Lighting/mood: delicate soft studio lighting, restrained soft shadows and highlights.
Color palette: white and pale neutral grey only with transparent alpha.
Materials/textures: tactile woven matte cloth, soft porcelain-like button, paper-like roll, tiny thread.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: show four related successive states of motion; retain same subject and styling; preserve true clean transparency outside silhouettes.
Avoid: colors, beige, black backgrounds, extra objects, readable text, labels, numbers, logos, watermark, grid lines, panel borders, dividers, camera or lighting changes, crude line art, cropped objects, different designs between panels.
